ns2:course.label: Reading and Writing Data
ns2:course.description: Explores how we tell stories and make arguments in the age of the internet and "big data." We will explore both creative and scholarly works that experiment with the forms of expression that digital and online media make possible, and others that question the cultural, political, and social consequences of computational media and data. Students will develop skills for writing _about data_ and writing _with data_ through a variety of media.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Advanced Composition, and Humanities - Lit & Arts course.
